title: Routeburn Track: Key Summit Track: Fiordland National Park, Fiordland region
overview: Enjoy panoramic views over mountains and alpine lakes on this half-day walk off Milford Road on the Routeburn Track - it's suitable families with children.
3.4 km one way, return via same track
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
